capabilities: Roll skills and attacks with d10 results including crits and fumbles
Track HP, wound penalties, Death Save and armor ablation
Manage weapons, ammo, cyberware and gear stored in note properties
Create characters with a wizard and add homebrew items, NPCs, roles and skills
Play from a phone layout with a sticky HP/SP/LUCK status bar
extras: Ships as a kit, not just a plugin: CSS snippet, Dataview item-card script, Templater templates, a Bases home page and an example vault. Requires the Cyberpunk RED Core Rulebook (not included, for licensing reasons); needs Obsidian 1.9+ for Bases; makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a tabletop RPG character: tracking stats, rolls, wounds and gear during play means manual note editing.
